sections.text: Introduction

These procedure details
the steps required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of Stator
earth fault relay . it is
recommended this procedure be carried out every four years bases the first
preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activates required
prior to testing .

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Moustafa Osman ,tested and revised by eng.Ali Ghater, accepted by eng. Farag Abo 
Youseff :general manager, approved by eng. Gomaa Ghater: head sector of Kafr 
el Dawar 
Power Station, and certified by eng. Gaber Mohmed Frahat : WDEPC inspection and 
quality control general director and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety 
 helmet ... etc

sections.text: Testing Procedures

Isolate the secondary terminal of the
voltage transformer.

Connect the voltage test set terminals to
L (A3), N (A4) 
and the timer to D5 , E5

Inject the single phase voltage to the
relay then increase the voltage gradually until the red flag for the relay
appear record V (pick up) and time.

Decrease the voltage gradually until the
red flag disappear then record V (reset).

sections.text: Return Relay and Associated Equipment to Service

Return relay to service by removing the
test terminal .

Make sure VT secondary circuits are in
normal condition.

If any equipment associated with the
relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service.
Return the work permit .
